issue.title: Inline work item creation shows generic error when title exceeds 255 characters

preconditions: Navigated to a project Work Items list view (not sidebar)
steps: Navigate to the SEED project Work Items list view
Click the inline 'Add work item' button (not modal/sidebar)
Type or paste a title that is exactly 256 characters long

oracle.expected: A generic error message like 'Some error occurred. Please try again.' appears instead of a descriptive validation message about title length exceeding 255 characters

teardown: None needed — failed creation leaves no artifact
